fields.title: 5. Proposed New Rules — None
fields.md:
The competing vehicles have not yet flown, and the loans are at the commitment stage. Whether to set up 'SpaceX's share of the annual NSSL assignments shrinks for the first time' as a probability rule will be decided in a monthly run after the first change in assignments appears in an official announcement — setting it up now would produce a rule without numbers. Existing proposals ①–⑤ are maintained (Source: `state.rule_proposals_not_applied`).
